Sheet1.QUESTIONS: What is the admission process?
Sheet1.ANSWER:
Admission to the University of Kerala is primarily online via admissions.keralauniversity.ac.in, 
with UG admissions based on merit (marks) and PG admissions largely through entrance exams 
(MA, MSc, MCom, MBA). Applicants must register, fill in details, pay fees online, and, if selected, report with original documents.

Sheet1.QUESTIONS: Eligibility for admission?
Sheet1.ANSWER: A pass in Higher Secondary Examination of the state or an Examination accepted by the university and 45% marks in aggregate.
